story_text: As a new user, I want to register with my name, email, and password so that I can create an account.

positive.title: Register with valid data
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, and password.
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

positive.title: Register with valid data and optional fields
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, password, and fill in phone number field
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

positive.title: Register with the same user name but different email
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, password, and a different email than the one used in TC-P01.
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

positive.title: Register with a name including Special Characters(e.g., /, *, &, etc.)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name with special characters, email, and password.
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

positive.title: Register with a name including Non-English Characters(e.g., Chinese, Arabic, etc.)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name with non-English characters, email, and password.
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

positive.title: Register with a name including numeric characters
steps: 2. Enter a valid name with numeric characters, email, and password.
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

positive.title: Register with a password that is exactly the minimum required length
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, and a password that is exactly the minimum required length (e.g., '12345678').
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

positive.title: Register with a all fields except the optional phone number field filled with valid data
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, and password, and leave the optional phone number field empty.
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

positive.title: Register with password including special characters
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, and password that includes special characters (e.g., 'P@ssw0rd!').
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

positive.title: Register with password including numeric characters
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, and password that includes numeric characters (e.g., 'Password123').
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

positive.title: Register with password including mixed case characters
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, and password that includes mixed case characters (e.g., 'PPassword').
positive.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

negative.title: Register with invalid email format
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, an invalid email format (e.g., 'userexample.com'), and a valid password.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for invalid email format.

negative.title: Register with a pre-registered email
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, a valid password, and an email that has already been registered.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for pre-registered email.

negative.title: Register with empty name field
steps: 2. Enter a valid email and a valid password.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for empty name field.

negative.title: Register with name field containing only spaces
steps: 2. Enter a name field containing only spaces, a valid email, and a valid password.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for name field containing only spaces.

negative.title: Register with empty password field
steps: 2. Enter a valid name and a valid email.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for empty password field.

negative.title: Register with all fields empty
negative.expected_result: Error messages displayed for all required fields being empty.

edge.title: Register with 1 character in the name field
steps: 2. Enter a name with only 1 character, a valid email, and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for name field containing only 1 character.

edge.title: Register with 2 characters in the name field
steps: 2. Enter a name with only 2 characters, a valid email, and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

edge.title: Register with 255 characters in the name field
steps: 2. Enter a name with 255 characters, a valid email, and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

edge.title: Register with 256 characters in the name field
steps: 2. Enter a name with 256 characters, a valid email, and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for name exceeding maximum character limit.

edge.title: Register with a space before the name field
steps: 2. Enter a name with a space before it, a valid email, and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for name field containing leading space.

edge.title: Register with a the shortest email address (e.g., a@b.c)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, the shortest email address (e.g., 'a@b.c'), and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

edge.title: Register with an email address that is exactly the maximum allowed length (e.g., 255 characters)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, an email address that is exactly the maximum allowed length (e.g., 255 characters), and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

edge.title: Register with an email adress that exceeds the maximum allowed length (e.g., 256 characters)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, an email address that exceeds the maximum allowed length (e.g., 256 characters), and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for email address exceeding maximum length.

edge.title: Register with an email adress that includes deep subdomains (e.g., @sub.sub.sub.domain.com)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, an email address that includes deep subdomains (e.g., @sub.sub.sub.domain.com), and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

edge.title: Register with a password that is exactly 7 characters long (the minimum required length is 8 characters)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, an email address, and a password that is exactly 7 characters long.
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for password not meeting minimum length requirement.

edge.title: Register with a password that is exactly 8 characters long (the minimum required length)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, an email address, and a password that is exactly 8 characters long.
edge.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

edge.title: Register with a password that is exactly 128 characters long (the maximum allowed length)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, an email address, and a password that is exactly 128 characters long.
edge.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

edge.title: Register with a password that exceeds the maximum allowed length (e.g., 129 characters)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, an email address, and a password that exceeds the maximum allowed length (e.g., 129 characters).
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for password exceeding maximum length.

edge.title: Register with a password that includes a space
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, an email address, and a password that includes a space.
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for password field containing a space.

edge.title: Register with the minimum valid length for phone number in the optional phone number field (e.g., 7 digits)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, password, and a phone number that is the minimum valid length (e.g., 7 digits).
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for phone number not meeting minimum length requirement.

edge.title: Register with the maximum valid length for phone number in the optional phone number field (e.g., 15 digits)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, password, and a phone number that is the maximum valid length (e.g., 15 digits).
edge.expected_result: Account created successfully and user is redirected to the welcome page.

edge.title: Register with a phone number that exceeds the maximum valid length in the optional phone number field (e.g., 16 digits)
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, password, and a phone number that exceeds the maximum valid length (e.g., 16 digits).
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for phone number exceeding maximum length.

edge.title: Register with a phone number that includes special characters in the optional phone number field (e.g., '+1 (123) 456-7890')
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, password, and a phone number that includes special characters (e.g., '+1 (123) 456-7890').
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for phone number containing invalid characters.

edge.title: Register with a phone number that includes spaces in the optional phone number field (e.g., '123 456 7890')
steps: 2. Enter a valid name, email, password, and a phone number that includes spaces (e.g., '123 456 7890').
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed for phone number containing invalid characters.
